desc: This Henry Repeating Arms® Golden Boy Youth Rifle is chambered for .22 Long (L)/.22 Short (S)/ .22 (LR) Long Rifle calibers. Elegant in design, this Henry Repeating Arms® Golden Boy Youth Rifle has 16 rounds of firepower with 22 long rifle and 21 rounds with .22 short. This Henry Repeating Arms® Golden Boy Youth Rifle would undoubtedly be a force to recon with and a rifle you would be proud to own.
